notes.title: Colorful Life Will Be Going Free to Play
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

As of February 12th, 2018, Colorful Life will be switching over to free to play.  This is primarily due to Onieronaut Academy shutting down and its members moving on. 

However, we wanted to keep the game up and give more people a chance to play it and hope that existing customers will have an easier time finding online games.

I'll be keeping an eye on things the best I can in terms of support but there likely wont be any major updates to the game moving forward.

Thank you to everyone who supported us and already purchased the game!

notes.title: Colorful Life Has Been Released!
notes.notes:
Well it took a little longer than we wanted but Colorful Life has finally been released!

I just wanted to post a few points of information in case you're unfamiliar with the game.

The first thing - this game is meant for 4 players only.  However, there is both local and online components so hopefully it won't be too difficult to gather your friends together to play.

Secondly, we highly recommend playing with a controller.  All the major ones should work.

Finally, and most importantly, there was only one developer with a small handful of testers working on this game.  Chances are we missed something or a feature may not be working 100% correctly.  While we did our best to iron out everything we found, if something unexpected happens, let us know by posting about it in the game forum.  We'll do our best to get a fix out ASAP.

Thanks and hope everyone enjoys the game!
